upstreams.subtitle: opencode Zen and Cline egress proxy configuration
upstreams.failoverActive: Failover in progress (requests temporarily routed to Cline pool)
upstreams.proxiesHint: http/https/socks5/socks5h supported, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080; empty = direct
upstreams.clineProxyIntro: Direct connections to api.cline.bot / api.workos.com from restricted regions hit geo-blocks; configure an egress proxy pool and all Cline-bound traffic (chat, login refresh, model sync) is rotated through it. Priority: in-app proxy > HTTPS_PROXY env > direct.

keys.deleteConfirm: Delete this key? Clients using it stop working immediately
keys.pwdPlaceholder: New password; submit empty = clear password
keys.usage: Client usage: header x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer <key>; Base URL: http://<host>:3457/v1

settings.subtitle: Rotation strategy, upstream headers, free chain and listen address
settings.strategyHint: round_robin: take turns; fill: exhaust one then move on; random: random
settings.hostHint: 0.0.0.0 exposes the service to the LAN; make sure the network is trusted
settings.modelChain: Free model chain (fallback order of the "free" alias)
settings.chainHint: Selection order becomes the fallback chain; empty uses the built-in chain
settings.headersHint: These headers are attached to Cline upstream requests; rows with empty Value are ignored.
